resource.name: Resolve Tools / Marker Madness Suite
resource.creator: resolve-tools.com
resource.description: Resolve Tools 2.1 combines Marker Madness, Clip Renamer Pro, Track Command, Clipper and Reel Time Plus in one desktop app. Adds scene-level continuity workbooks/PDF reports and Premiere/Avid marker exchange. Requires Resolve Studio 21.1+; the frozen Classic Python scripts for older versions remain separately listed.
resource.platformNotes: macOS 12+ or Windows 10/11 x64. Studio 21.1+; installers are unsigned. No independent catalogue installation test.

requirements.dependencies: Resolve Studio with External scripting using set to Local. Windows requires WebView2.
requirements.installation: macOS DMG or Windows EXE; provider documents unsigned installers.
